create_safe_greenlet: create a context-managed greenlet that enforces the one-reachable-child constraint for safe concurrency
run_easy_greenlet: run a function in a SafeGreenlet wrapped in an EasyGenerator for ergonomic sendval and retval access
use_yield_from: use yield_from to delegate to a sub-iterator from within a greenlet, equivalent to builtin yield from
test_local_context_manager: test LocalContextManager to keep a context open only in the current greenlet and close it when switching away
review_yield_: review yield_ for nonlocal yield from deep in a call stack without changing the whole call stack
